title: Happy National Dog Day!
description:
Today, we’re celebrating the dogs who serve our city and the ones who make up our community. From SDPD and SDFD K9 units, to the pets we meet at our free clinics for those experiencing homelessness, and the dogs who enjoy our dog parks, happy National Dog Day!🐾💛 

Looking for a new spot to go? The City of San Diego offers designated areas for dogs to freely play, exercise, and socialize. There are 20+ designated dog off-leash areas: webmaps.sandiego.gov/portal/apps/storymaps/stories/9bda81a5f7c6489fb87c218a9c7ce605

#CityOfSanDiego #dog
